title: IRIS Lab photos and videos
description: Lab media catalog. The Photos page lists every image, newest first. Videos stay in this file and on disk and are not shown. Order in the file does not matter.

id.description: Unique id, lowercase, usually dated-folder plus a short slug.

type.description: image uses src (WebP) and fallback (JPEG or PNG). video uses an H.264 MP4 in src plus a poster.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Shown on the card. Newest dates are listed first.

src.description: Absolute URL of the WebP (image) or H.264 MP4 (video) under assets/media/lab/.

fallback.description: Absolute URL of the JPEG or PNG shown when the browser has no WebP.

poster.description: Absolute URL of the video poster frame. Required for video.

width.description: Pixel width of the optimized file, at most 1600.

height.description: Pixel height of the optimized file.

alt.description: What a screen reader should say. Required for images and videos.

caption.description: Optional visible caption. Omit it, or use an empty string, for none.
